stories.headline_de: Islamische Kunstbiennale 2027 präsentiert Kuratoren

stories.headline_en: Ayer directs Pitt, military dog in war drama
stories.headline_de: Ayer inszeniert Pitt und Militärhund im Kriegsdrama
stories.summary_en: Director David Ayer, a former US Army member, explores soldier narratives in his new film. The production stars Brad Pitt and a traumatized military dog as lead characters.

stories.headline_en: Dörrie explores elderly care in robot-assisted future
stories.headline_de: Dörrie erforscht Altenpflege in robotergestützter Zukunft
stories.summary_en: Doris Dörrie's new film "Frau Winkler verlässt das Haus" follows an elderly woman cared for by a care robot. The film presents a melancholic vision of a near-future scenario.
stories.summary_de: Doris Dörries neuer Film "Frau Winkler verlässt das Haus" folgt einer alten Frau, die von einem Pflegeroboter betreut wird. Der Film präsentiert eine melancholische Vision eines nahen Szenarios der Zukunft.

stories.headline_en: Restaurant bathrooms become key design destination
stories.headline_de: Restauranttoiletten werden zur Designdestination
stories.summary_en: Restaurant restrooms have evolved from functional necessity to curated aesthetic experience, now integral to hospitality branding. Design ranges from luxe to pared-back, often optimized for social media sharing.

stories.headline_en: Week in wildlife: global animal photography highlights
stories.headline_de: Tierwelt der Woche: Tierfotografie weltweit

stories.headline_en: Ai Weiwei Exhibits 500 Helmets on Ukraine Aid
stories.headline_de: Ai Weiwei zeigt 500 Helme zu Deutschlands Ukraine-Hilfe
stories.summary_en: Artist Ai Weiwei presents a work of 500 helmets addressing Germany's contested support for Ukraine. The installation comments on debates surrounding German military assistance.
stories.summary_de: Künstler Ai Weiwei präsentiert ein Werk aus 500 Helmen zu Deutschlands umstrittener Ukraine-Unterstützung. Die Installation kommentiert Debatten über deutsche Militärhilfe.

stories.headline_en: Benedikt Taschen Selling Midcentury LA Home for $25M
stories.headline_de: Benedikt Taschen verkauft Midcentury-Haus für 25M

stories.headline_en: 23-year-old Uche Yara joins Bilderbuch as guitarist
stories.headline_de: 23-Jährige Uche Yara wird Gitarristin von Bilderbuch

stories.headline_en: India at the 61st Venice Biennale explores home
stories.headline_de: Indien auf der 61. Biennale Venedig erforscht Heimat

stories.headline_en: Turner Prize 2026 showcase opens with four nominees
stories.headline_de: Turner Prize 2026 Ausstellung mit vier Nominierten eröffnet

stories.headline_en: Ai Weiwei on new 40m sculpture and art's role
stories.headline_de: Ai Weiwei über neue 40-m-Skulptur und Kunst
stories.summary_en: The artist discusses his 40 metre sculpture Mushrooms at Sydney Harbour from his Portuguese farm, where he has lived for six years. He reflects on war, peace, and the state of the world.

stories.headline_en: Armory Show Characterized as Quiet
stories.headline_de: Armory Show als ruhig charakterisiert
stories.summary_en: This year's Armory Show edition is described as notably quiet and downcast compared to adjacent events. The contrast is made with financial sector activity on the fairground.

stories.headline_en: Independent 20th Century at the Breuer
stories.headline_de: Independent 20th Century im Breuer
stories.summary_en: Independent 20th Century fair showcases spectacular works at the Breuer Building, which has been transformed into an art market venue. The scale and presentation raise questions about the nature of contemporary art fairs
stories.summary_de: Die Messe Independent 20th Century präsentiert spektakuläre Werke im Breuer Building, das in einen Kunstmarktplatz umgewandelt wurde. Umfang und Präsentation werfen Fragen über die Art zeitgenössischer Kunstmessen auf.

stories.headline_en: Emil Bisttram's Atomic Visions Displayed at Independent
stories.headline_de: Emil Bisttrams Atomare Visionen auf der Independent

stories.headline_en: Armory Show Reports Sales After September Move
stories.headline_de: Armory Show meldet Verkäufe nach September-Umzug
stories.summary_en: The Armory Show's relocation to late September resulted in a quieter opening morning, though dealers reported sales ranging from thousands to six figures.
stories.summary_de: Die Verlegung der Armory Show auf Ende September führte zu einem ruhigeren Eröffnungstag, wobei Galeristen Verkäufe von Tausenden bis in sechsstellige Beträge meldeten.

stories.headline_en: Polish Pavilion uses whale song for accessibility dialogue
stories.headline_de: Polnischer Pavillon nutzt Walgesang für Barrierefreiheit
stories.summary_en: The Polish Pavilion at Venice Biennale employs whale songs as a communication tool. The work explores accessibility through sound-based dialogue.
stories.summary_de: Der Polnische Pavillon auf der Biennale Venedig nutzt Walgesänge als Kommunikationsmittel. Das Werk erforscht Barrierefreiheit durch soundgestützte Dialoge.

stories.headline_en: 36 Artifacts Returned to Syria from New York
stories.headline_de: 36 Artefakte von New York an Syrien zurückgegeben
stories.summary_en: New York investigators returned 36 artifacts to Syria, including a relief looted from Palmyra. The Manhattan District Attorney's office also seized 13 pieces from the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

stories.headline_de: Bea Scaccias Debüt bei Gagosian

stories.headline_en: Newly Attributed Goya in 2028 Prado Show
stories.headline_de: Neu zugeschriebenes Goya-Werk in Prado-Schau 2028
stories.summary_en: A painting newly speculated to be by Goya will feature in a 2028 exhibition at Museo del Prado. The work had previously been attributed to the artist's brother-in-law.

stories.headline_en: El Museo del Barrio apologizes for 9/11 event rental
stories.headline_de: El Museo del Barrio entschuldigt sich für 9/11-Event
stories.summary_en: The Harlem institution issued an apology after renting space for an event, stating it was not aware of the full program details. The museum cited lack of knowledge about content and speakers.

stories.headline_en: Jonathan Abbott named MOCA Los Angeles director

stories.headline_en: Greek PM rejects Parthenon Marbles-Bayeux Tapestry analogy

stories.headline_en: Art world's fascination with mannequins explored
stories.headline_de: Kunstwelt beschäftigt sich mit Schaufensterpuppen

stories.headline_en: Spring/Break fair debuts in former CBS News studio
stories.headline_de: Spring/Break-Messe in ehemaliger CBS-Newsroom

stories.headline_en: Spring Break art fair explores colonialism, psychology
stories.headline_de: Spring Break Kunstmesse befasst sich mit Kolonialismus

stories.headline_en: 2026 Turner Prize features four finalists at MIMA
stories.headline_de: Turner Prize 2026 mit vier Finalisten im MIMA
stories.summary_en: The 2026 Turner Prize features finalists Marguerite Humeau, Tanoa Sasraku, Simeon Barclay, and Kira Freije at Middlesbrough Institute of Modern Art. The exhibition addresses themes of apocalypse, greed, and grief.

stories.headline_en: Maison Estelle under police investigation, cancels Frieze events

stories.headline_en: Hamburger Kunsthalle Acquires Runge Work

stories.headline_de: Rachel Kneebone zeigt Porzellan-Skulpturen

stories.summary_de: Rachel Kneebone zeigt neun Porzellan-Werke (2017–2026) in der Wallace Collection. Ihre schwebenden Skulpturen kombinieren Bänder und Blütenformen in labiler Balance.

stories.headline_en: Nicole Eisenman balances abstraction and reality
stories.headline_de: Nicole Eisenman zwischen Himmel und Wirklichkeit

stories.headline_en: Hans J Wegner and the history of modern chair design

stories.headline_en: Richard Ford publishes career retrospective "In einfachen Worten"

stories.headline_en: Group bans smartphones to explore tech-free connection
